title: CSRF token on login not invalidated after use
description: The user_token CSRF token can be reused multiple times with the same PHP session. If an attacker obtains a valid token (e.g., via XSS), they can replay it for repeated authentication attempts.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/login.php; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=oh7b9qbtd9c0dueninuaf8i9h1; path=/ Set-Cookie: security=low
